notes: NEX3 Arbitration Decision · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY · no runtime. v0.2.0 aligns with founder's Step 2 verdict list: NEX1_BETTER · NEX2_BETTER · EXISTING_CODE_BETTER · BOTH_INFERIOR · HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED. Adds explicit evidence_bundle_ids · conflicts · missing_evidence · rollback_reference · anti-false-precision rule.

required_fields.name: candidates
required_fields.shape: array of { candidate_id, source, diff_ref } · at least NEX1 · optionally NEX2 · optionally BASELINE

required_fields.name: user_objective
required_fields.shape: string · founder or user-authored intent statement

required_fields.name: project_constraints
required_fields.shape: object · project style · frameworks · locked ADRs

required_fields.name: evidence_bundle_ids
required_fields.shape: array of bundle_id · one per candidate

required_fields.name: criterion_results
required_fields.shape: object · one entry per criterion · each holds { state, cited_evidence_ids, delta, notes }

required_fields.name: conflicts
required_fields.notes: NEX3 exposes trade-offs · never hides them

required_fields.name: missing_evidence
required_fields.shape: array of dimension names for which NO evidence was available
required_fields.notes: load-bearing · every unmeasured dimension appears here

required_fields.name: verdict
required_fields.shape: enum · NEX1_BETTER · NEX2_BETTER · EXISTING_CODE_BETTER · BOTH_INFERIOR · HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED
required_fields.notes: only these six · no invented verdicts

required_fields.name: rationale
required_fields.notes: if rationale references a fact · that fact MUST have a cited_evidence_id

required_fields.name: limitations
required_fields.shape: string · what this decision does NOT cover

required_fields.name: rollback_reference
required_fields.shape: string · describes how to reverse the accepted candidate

required_fields.name: authority_boundary
required_fields.notes: NEX3 verdict is advisory · founder authorisation converts it to binding

verdict_semantics.NEX1_BETTER: NEX1 candidate wins on evidence across the 10 criteria · rationale MUST cite specific evidence_ids
verdict_semantics.NEX2_BETTER: NEX2 alternative wins on evidence · same citation discipline
verdict_semantics.EXISTING_CODE_BETTER: neither candidate improves the baseline · take no action · existing code retained
verdict_semantics.BOTH_INFERIOR: both candidates worse than baseline · design must be revisited · nothing accepted
verdict_semantics.HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: evidence bundle contains too many NOT_MEASURED / BLOCKED / INCONCLUSIVE for a verdict · request additional measurement
verdict_semantics.USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED: user_objective is ambiguous or contradictory · verdict withheld pending clarification

invariants: no verdict is fabricated · every verdict is reconstructable from criterion_results and evidence_bundle_ids
every criterion appearing in the verdict rationale MUST cite an evidence_id
any criterion state ∈ {NOT_MEASURED, BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE} REDUCES overall_confidence · NEVER contributes to a positive verdict
NEX3 does not decide on style · tone · popularity · charisma
NEX3 may return HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED · NEVER forced to CHOOSE
authority_boundary is constant · not runtime-modifiable · verdict is advisory until founder authorises
conflicts field MUST enumerate every trade-off encountered · trade-offs are exposed · never hidden
anti_false_precision: verdicts do NOT include composite numeric scores like '87.3% better'
criterion_results record deterministic evidence (measured, delta, state) · NOT synthetic aggregate percentages
if a criterion cannot be measured deterministically · state=INCONCLUSIVE · never a manufactured number
hold_conditions: any load-bearing criterion in NOT_MEASURED · BLOCKED · INCONCLUSIVE
missing_evidence array non-empty for the operation kind
conflicts include a trade-off with no user-preference signal
adversarial fixtures for the operation kind are absent
candidates disagree on which existing behaviour they preserve
reproducibility_information missing on any load-bearing evidence
